newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil govt sees CVRD sale in March.
newsitem.headline: Brazil govt sees CVRD sale in March.

text.p: The privatization of Brazilian mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce SA will probably take place in March 1997 but that date does not represent a postponement of the selloff, a Planning Ministry spokeswoman said.

"The government is thinking (the CVRD privatization) will happen in March," the spokeswoman said. "The government has always said the sale will take place in the first quarter and has never mentioned months." Many observers have said they believed the government intended to hold a block sale of 40-45 percent of CVRD's voting shares in February.

Newspapers on Wednesday quoted the president of the National Development Bank (BNDES), Luiz Carlos Mendonca de Barros, as saying investors wanted more time to study CVRD documents and Planning Minister Antonio Kandir had agreed to extend the consultation period.
Mendonca de Barros was also reported to have said that an agreement that the Senate be given 30 days to study CVRD's privatization details before their publication made a February sale unlikely.
"All this leads us to believe there will be a delay in the initial timetable," the BNDES president told O Estado de Sao Paulo daily.
"The government is not worried about dates but rather that the process is perfectly transparent."
